corporate.rd_note: Guided R&D $2.9B (2026), GAAP opex $4.2-4.6B (2027) -> R&D ~$2.65B 2027. Unallocated = discovery/platform ($356M 2025) + tech-dev + shared + SBC not attributable to named programs (10-K 2025 R&D table: only $0.9B of $3.1B is program-specific external spend). Its full cost is charged. Offsetting credit for the pipeline it will create: early_pipeline_factor x after-tax PV of [platform share of unallocated R&D 2027-32 + ALL unallocated R&D from 2033 (when named programs are done)]. 1.0 = R&D earns exactly its cost of capital (NPV-neutral); 0.75 base reflects Moderna's mixed recent R&D productivity (CMV fail, flu 3-yr delay, noro interim miss vs mNEXSPIKE, INT success). JUDGMENT.

scenarios.prob_note: Positive Ph3 oncology BLAs are approved ~85-90% of the time; interim success at a pre-specified IA implies HR well below 0.75 but magnitude undisclosed until ESMO. Launch-vs-consensus base rate: roughly 2/3 of launches under-deliver sell-side peak forecasts. Moderna's own launch record: Spikevax (pandemic) >> guide; mRESVIA << guide; mNEXSPIKE in line. Revenue-guidance confidence 65/100 (1y) falling to 47 (3y). -> downside-skewed weights. JUDGMENT.

failure.desc: ESMO data weak (HR ~0.85) / FDA (CBER) requires OS -> melanoma not approved; readthrough cuts other INT PoS by 60%; respiratory bear.

bear.desc: Melanoma approved 2028 with modest HR (~0.75), price ~$200k US; NSCLC PoS cut; COVID erodes faster; flu/combo half of base.

base.desc: Assumptions as listed: melanoma launch 2027, US net ~$300k, $2.8B global peak; other indications at stated PoS; respiratory bottom-up.

bull.desc: Strong ESMO HR (~0.55) with OS trend; US net ~$420k (William Blair models $475k WAC); melanoma peak $5B; other INT PoS x1.33 incl. future tumours; respiratory ~$5-6B (mgmt path).

blue_sky.desc: Ceiling test, NOT weighted: every INT indication succeeds (PoS=100%), peaks x1.5, US net ~$475k (William Blair WAC), 62% margin, respiratory bull, WACC 8.0%, g=2%, R&D fully value-creating.

multiples.note: Fitted ln(EV/Sales) = a + b*3y growth + c*op margin on 13 commercial-scale peers (data/peers.json); applied to Moderna 2030E attributable revenue (respiratory + 50% INT + royalties) and discounted 3.25 years at WACC.

transactions.note: Large biopharma M&A typically priced at ~2.5-4.5x risk-adjusted peak sales (e.g., Pfizer/Seagen 2023, AbbVie/ImmunoGen 2023, BMS/Karuna 2023, J&J/Intra-Cellular 2025 - deal values public; peak-sales denominators are sell-side approximations, not retrieved in this session). Moderna-sized ($80B) acquirer universe is small.
